newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya Commercial Bank profits up in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Kenya Commercial Bank profits up in 1996.

text.p: Kenya Commercial Bank (KCB) on Wednesday posted a pre-tax profit of 4.045 billion shillings ($73.67 million) in the trading year to 31 December 1996 compared to 3.784 billion shillings in the previous year.

"This (result) represents an increase of seven percent. The satisfactory trading results are attributable to efficient treasury management and prudent lending," KCB Executive Chairman Alexander Kaminchia said in a statement.
Kaminchia posted profits after tax at 2.5 billion shillings in 1996 compared to 2.372 billion shillings in 1995.
Kaminchia said directors had recommended the payment of a final dividend of 3.50 for a total dividend of 7.0, a shilling higher than the total dividend of 6.0 paid out in 1995.
The results were issued after close of business at the Nairobi Stock Exchange where KCB stock was unchanged at 97.
